summary: Agent-first OS: Linux LTS base, agentd as PID 1/control plane, terminal-first UX, generic Agent Core Runtime, semantic capability execution, audit and rollback before autonomy. Production Distro RC7 is closed with PASS final audit, still not GA: signed metadata projection, revocation snapshot, installer compatibility, rollback baseline, HTTPS mirror hardening, gated canary activation denial, and gated rollback drill denial are proved, but exact approval, 2+ canary targets, AgentCore PlanSpec binding, SecurityExecutionEngine approval, activation execution, and rollback execution remain missing. Production Distro RC8 is closed with PASS final audit: RC8 Wave 0 is complete; RC8-010 projected a real payload object descriptor candidate from current build bytes; RC8-011 ingested the existing public detached signature for that payload with crypto verification and redacted receipt; RC8-012 proved signed object descriptor fail-closed fixtures across descriptor, signature, receipt, revocation, freshness, redaction, and authority broadening cases; RC8-020 ran QEMU installer VM preflight and repo-local quarantine byte smoke; RC8-021 proved installer byte, signature, storage, compatibility, redaction, and side-effect authority negative fixtures fail closed; RC8-022 refreshed HTTPS mirror metadata and frontend consistency for the real RC8 payload while preserving metadata-only and install-blocked semantics; RC8-030 projected exact-approved canary activation smoke evidence under AgentCore and SecurityExecutionEngine and denied activation fail-closed; RC8-031 projected controlled rollback drill evidence through AgentCore rollback PlanSpec and SecurityExecutionEngine gates and denied rollback fail-closed; RC8-032 bound support/recovery evidence to the controlled execution smoke with a redacted local support bundle projection and recovery reference index while keeping support upload, recovery, activation, rollback, remote dispatch, and TUI authority disabled. RC8-040 final closeout audit passed with 19 checks and 0 blockers. The payload remains non-GA and install-blocked. Production Distro RC9 is active: RC9 Wave 0 is complete; RC9-001 froze the external object storage and controlled canary execution contract; RC9-002 froze external object descriptor publication and declared/current artifact drift reconciliation contract; RC9-003 froze exact approval, target enrollment, AgentCore PlanSpec, and SecurityExecutionEngine binding contract, preserving metadata-only mirror semantics and non-GA authority boundaries. RC9-010 projected an immutable external object publication candidate for the RC8 payload bytes and produced expected publication-denied evidence because no external HTTPS object URI is published. RC9-011 reconciled declared/current artifact drift into drift-denied evidence with 30 comparisons and 13 drift ids, preserving metadata-only mirror semantics and blocking external object trust. RC9-012 projected external object installer fetch and fail-closed evidence; fetch was denied before network because the external HTTPS object URI is missing and drift remains denied, with 9 fail-closed cases and no payload download, quarantine write, install, activation, rollback, support upload, or remote dispatch. Next work is RC9-020 two-node canary enrollment.
